typedArtifactAndPayloadBoundary.ownerReferenceIdentity: artifactPublicId is a server-generated canonical lowercase UUID and the reference UUID suffix equals it byte-for-byte.
typedArtifactAndPayloadBoundary.tupleEquality: Every member equals the owner-resolved stored value byte-for-byte after canonical UUID and lowercase sha256 normalization.
typedArtifactAndPayloadBoundary.immutability: A configurationId and version binds exactly one artifact public UUID and digest. Corrections create a new Platform version and new owner artifact version; update in place, reverse synchronization and a second mutable template aggregate are forbidden.
typedArtifactAndPayloadBoundary.transitRule: Platform treats ownerPayload as opaque transit-only JSON and never persists, logs, audits or echoes it. People owns parsing, canonical validation, encryption and durable storage.

trustedOwnerHandshake.endpointRule: Only the exact method and canonical path, allowlisted caller and audience, signed tenant, endpoint purpose, request-body sha256, distinct canonical UUID jti and requestNonce and matching authenticated workload identity are admitted. Duplicate or conflicting security claims and browser authority headers fail before repository use.
trustedOwnerHandshake.transportRule: Use bounded timeout, redirects disabled, no TLS downgrade, no trust-all client and no static gateway token fallback.
trustedOwnerHandshake.prepare: Accept only the three sealed schema variants with server-derived Platform facts and opaque ownerPayload. Canonicalize, validate, encrypt and persist one immutable owner artifact plus PREPARED evidence, returning only server-derived reference, digest and attestation. Exact identity and digest replay returns the same result; conflicts fail closed.
trustedOwnerHandshake.finalize: Bind the exact prepared artifact to one Platform configuration version and create receipt idempotently. Conflicting tuple, receipt chain or already-bound artifact fails with no mutation. Validation remains blocked until the exact finalization acknowledgement is committed by Platform.
trustedOwnerHandshake.validate: Reload the exact finalized tuple under RLS, decrypt and canonical-verify the payload, execute the owner schema rules and append one immutable validation receipt bound to the tuple.
trustedOwnerHandshake.simulate: Resolve the exact validation receipt and owner-resolved trusted sample scope, run deterministic domain simulation and append one immutable simulation receipt plus impact digest bound to the tuple and validation receipt.
trustedOwnerHandshake.ownerProjection: People queries trusted Platform lifecycle metadata at the same asOf for IAQ assembly. Platform unavailable yields PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE and never a local lifecycle fallback.
trustedOwnerHandshake.authoritativeCreateLookup: Only BOUND or signed ABSENT_FINAL under the exact durable Platform admission fence is authoritative. UNKNOWN, timeout, in-flight, stale, unresolved or unfenced absence keeps PREPARED retryable; only exact ABSENT_FINAL may permit quarantine.
